summary: Backend-only tests for the new AI drafts + Notifications feature and helpers.py refactor regression. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py (9 tests, 100% passing). Seeded two owners, one 'cleaning' member session, and 4 conversations directly in Mongo; NO Lodgify endpoints were called. All expected behaviors verified: filter (ai_draft present AND ai_draft_validated != true), correct count, cleaning-member gate returns {count:0,items:[]}, multi-user isolation (owner2 does not see owner1's drafts), 401 without token. Refactor regression: GET /api/properties, /api/reservations, /api/preferences (statuses/status_colors/commission_rates/payment_methods keys + core status keys), /api/dashboard (shape + revenue_month for owner) all pass. Test data cleaned up via teardown (verified in Mongo).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2560 lines — still large; consider further module splits (inbox / notifications / channel / stripe / analytics) in a follow-up. helpers.py extraction is clean.

GET /api/notifications and /api/notifications/count apply _prop_scope('property_id') on conversations. Verified working for owner (unrestricted). Note: conversations synced from Lodgify must have property_id set for member-scoped roles that DO have inbox access; not in scope for this test but worth watching.
seed_data_creation: Inserted directly into Mongo and removed at teardown: 2 users (user_TEST_*), 3 user_sessions (owner1, owner2, cleaning member), 1 member (mbr_TEST_* role=cleaning bound to owner1), 1 property (prop_TEST_*), 4 conversations (TEST_thread_A/B/C/D). Verified post-run: 0 test conversations/members/properties/sessions remain; the pre-existing 1 stale user 'user_TEST_prefiso_*' is from a previous iteration, not this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py -v. The suite is fully self-contained (module-scoped fixture seeds + cleans Mongo). Auth uses direct user_sessions insertion; no OAuth call needed. Do NOT test /api/inbox/{thread}, /api/inbox/{thread}/generate-draft or /api/inbox/{thread}/reply — those hit a live Lodgify account and could send a real message to a real guest.
